scope: Every EXAM_BANK card: rendered source details, empty and wrong answers, opposite quadratic root, final answer, hints, full step input, and horizontal layout. Step values reuse trainer factories for UI integration; independent mathematics is checked separately.
snapshotPolicy: The trainer HTML was read once before the run and served unchanged in every browser batch. The final workspace file has the same SHA-256.
resumptionReason: Runs on this exact HTML snapshot were interrupted by Chromium Target crashed after 134 and 215 completed scenarios. Remaining scenarios resumed only after SHA-256 equality and clean prior evidence were checked; assertions and timeouts were retained.
limits: This browser run verifies interaction and rendering. It does not independently establish the mathematical values or external-source provenance. Browser contexts restarted after up to 20 cards in the first execution and 10 cards on resumptions to bound retained DOM/browser memory.

visualFindings.description: When About this task is expanded, its source badge remains absolutely positioned at the top right of the whole task card and overlaps part of the equation prompt. The mobile media rule already makes the badge static.
